name: Mixed Presentation Salad
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 2

Flavor Profiles temperature, bitter
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, texture, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 2

DESCRIPTION

Mixed presentation salad is a combination of at least 3 different vegetables that give a boost to mind and body alike.

When consumed, it grants a +1 resistance bonus on all Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the bonus and serving size by +1 each, to a maximum of +1 per 2 levels.
